name: Dune Sea
blurb: A sand sea of long dune ridges broken by flat-topped mesas, with a dry wadi winding across the line, a white salt flat, and a palm oasis by each airfield.
axes: metres; +X right, +Y up, +Z from the blue base toward the red base (same as the browser game)
